summary: Returns the value as a version string, or throws.
description: Dot-separated groups of digits, any number of them. A pre-release suffix, a leading `v` and an empty group are all rejected, so `"1.2.3-beta"` does not pass even though SemVer allows it.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

params.message: The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted.
params.strict: When `true`, a string counts as empty only if it has no characters at all; by default whitespace is trimmed first.

returns: the same value, typed as a version string.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the value is not a version string.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
requireValidVersion("1"); // => "1"
requireValidVersion("1.2.3"); // => "1.2.3"
requireValidVersion("1.2.3-beta"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidVersion("v1.2"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
